Iron ore in structural decline; BHP under severe pressure as commodity crumbles
Santos gas cartel breaking, reshaping energy sector dynamics

Gold mining names (Manhattan, Forrestania, Kaiser, Aureka) showing strength amid geopolitical risk
Qantas $35M payout to fired workers signals ongoing industrial pressure

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural decline ('drowning, not waving'); BHP under existential pressure. Gold miners (Manhattan, Forrestania, Kaiser, Aureka, Larvotto) benefit from geopolitical safe-haven demand and silver above $66.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face continued downside on iron ore. Gold names (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX, MNG.AX, KAL.AX, AUK.AX) offer relative strength. Diversify away from iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as rate hike bets rise on inflation concerns. RBA deputy governor hawkish. Mortgage rates easing slightly but household stress mounting. Property sector 'GFC moment' threatens NPLs.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate volatility and property credit risk. Monitor NPL trends and RBA path closely.

sectors.trend: Santos gas cartel breaking; Hormuz Strait escalation drives oil higher. Energy sector sees structural shift in gas pricing dynamics.
sectors.implications: STO.AX faces competitive pressure from cartel break. Oil-linked names (WDS.AX, WES.AX) benefit from higher crude. LNG exporters gain from supply disruption.

sectors.trend: Qantas $35M payout signals cost pressure. Living standards collapse; Aussies taking second jobs. Supply crunch hitting auto sector. Tobacco tax fight intensifying.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX under cost pressure. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) defensive appeal. Tobacco (BAT, JN) face regulatory headwinds.

sectors.trend: Novartis twin drug setbacks and Boston Scientific cyberattack signal global pharma risk. CSL relatively insulated but sector sentiment cautious.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (health) offer defensive positioning. Monitor global pharma pipeline risk spillover.

sectors.trend: Property industry faces 'GFC moment'; NZ house price crash returns. Housing funding stand-off threatens hundreds with homelessness. Construction capacity crisis.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX) face occupancy and valuation risk. Construction names (WBC.AX exposure, WES.AX) pressured by capacity constraints.

key_themes: Geopolitical risk premium: US-Iran conflict, Hormuz Strait battle driving oil and safe-haven flows
RBA hawkish pivot: inflation concerns driving rate hike expectations, pressuring banks and property
Iron ore structural decline: BHP and peers face existential commodity risk
Property sector stress: GFC-level concerns, NZ crash, mortgage affordability crisis
Gold/silver strength: Geopolitical safe-haven demand supports ASX gold miners
Living standards collapse: Public sector boom masking private sector deterioration
Energy transition: Santos cartel break reshapes gas market

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy and gold exposure; maintain cash buffers; monitor oil price thresholds
Reduce duration in rate-sensitive sectors (property, REITs); favour fixed-income and dividend payers
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and diversified miners
Monitor bank NPLs; reduce REIT exposure; watch NZ spillover to Australian markets

risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify internationally; maintain defensive positioning ahead of US midterms
Assess agricultural and insurance exposure; monitor commodity supply impacts

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight ASX gold miners on geopolitical safe-haven demand
opportunities.rationale: Silver above $66, gold supported by Iran conflict; multiple ASX gold names hitting milestones (Forrestania 2Moz, Manhattan high-grade, Kaiser reload)

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on Hormuz Strait disruption
opportunities.rationale: Oil rising on geopolitical risk; Santos cartel break creates pricing volatility favouring integrated players

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Living standards collapse and rate uncertainty favour defensive, dividend-paying sectors

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge iron ore exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; BHP facing existential pressure; no near-term catalyst for recovery
GFC-level property stress, NZ crash, mortgage affordability crisis, and RBA hawkishness create downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash and short-duration bonds as rate uncertainty persists
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA deputy governor hawkish; rate hike bets rising; CD rates at 4.35% offer attractive yield

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months. Rate hike bets, iron ore weakness, and property stress weigh on banks and materials. Geopolitical oil spikes create volatility. Gold miners and energy names outperform. RBA commentary remains the key domestic driver.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Structural iron ore decline, property sector reckoning, and living standards erosion cap upside. However, gold/silver strength, energy transition, and potential RBA pivot if growth slows could create selective opportunities. US midterms and Trump policy add global uncertainty.
